description:
Get detailed drug mechanism of action information.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table drug_mechanism_of_action — one record = one mechanism of action (action on one target) shared by one or more molecules.
Key: mechanismOfAction, actionType, targetName (actionType and targetName may be null).
Arguments: drug_id accepts chembl molecule or drug name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. ChEMBL mechanisms of action; absence means none curated.

schema.description: Pass at least one of: drug_id, mechanism. At most one of: drug_id, mechanism.

drug_id.description: Accepts chembl_molecule, drug_name; resolved to one chembl_molecule (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
